purpose: Read-only resource discovery and preparation; no workflows submitted.

evidence: Installed CLI node provisioner get team15 returned id=team15 and resource.annotations[fuzzball.io/provisioner_definition_id]=team15.
Complete installed CLI node list --output json returned 42 nodes. Exactly two have definitionId=team15; both also carry the matching resource annotation.
Read-only workflow_score with_checks=true accepted the workflow pinned to team15 using the current team15 context.
Negative control changed only the provisioner annotation to a nonexistent definition; scheduling preflight rejected it with no suitable provision definition found for job gpu-smoke.

policy.group_compute_policy: No compute policy grants configured for this group.
policy.qualification: These empty grant lists do not independently establish an exclusive group ACL. The assignment evidence is the named provisioner, explicit node mapping, and successful scoped scheduling preflight. Definition policy expressions and the central enforcement setting were not exposed by the inspected member-facing metadata. No administrator access was requested.

compute.availability_caveat: Ready/healthy is a metadata snapshot, not a reservation. GPU free counts are not evidence of idle GPUs. Hostnames were identified from provisioner metadata, not their numeric suffixes.
compute.response_limit_note: MCP node_list with full resource objects was explicitly truncated to 25 of 42 nodes. The CLI's full JSON response was used to establish the two matching nodes.

team.evidence: volume provisioner info team15 --output json lists team15 explicitly in accessPolicy, createPolicy, and ephemeralPolicy group names.

scratch.evidence: volume provisioner info team15-scratch lists team15 under ephemeralPolicy; driver.local=true.

shared.evidence: MCP volume_list and targeted volume_info(shared,datasets) both returned the volume; provisioner accessPolicy.all=true authorizes existing-volume access.
shared.qualification: Volume metadata and a mount access policy do not establish file contents, file-level permissions, model weights, or tested runtime compatibility. Capacity was not reported; that does not imply an empty volume.
shared.possible_future_inspection: A separately approved short job with a genuinely read-only datasets mount could list bounded filenames/sizes. No file-browser service or volume-mount job was launched.

group_object_cache.evidence: MCP object_list returned objects=[] and total=0.
